shortDesc.message: Realtime pitch shifter for any web audio. Tune YouTube, SoundCloud and other browser sound without converting files.

storeDesc.message:
Drakon Rhym is a realtime pitch shifter for any audio or video that plays in your browser. Drop the key to match your voice, raise it for instrument practice, or experiment for fun — all without converting files.

Features
- Works on YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify Web and any HTML5 media on the open web
- Pitch range -6 to +6 semitones with quick-step buttons (-1, -0.5, +0.5, +1)
- UI in English, Vietnamese and Japanese
- Settings sync across your Chrome profile

Open the popup, drag the slider, and the audio in the current tab follows in realtime.
